prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE full-color full-body combat-ready pose illustration in the SAME crisp SD PIXEL ART style as IMAGE1. IMAGE1 is the exact line-cleaned FRONTv01 blond dual-wield warrior: preserve his identity, ORIGINALv01 head-to-body proportions (not the later gigantic-head options), youthful male face, brown eyes, layered gold spiky hair, color palette, armor and equipment design. IMAGE2 is hand/handle grasp anatomy ONLY, do not copy its tall adult proportions/cape/armor/sword.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Imagine an opponent off-screen to SCREEN RIGHT. Show this SAME warrior in a FRONT THREE-QUARTER about45-degree view, facing and looking to SCREEN RIGHT, holding a convincing grounded dual-wield battle-ready stance. This is ONE key-pose still image of readiness, not an animation sheet. BOTH eyes and part of the front breastplate remain visible, far eye narrower; not a90-degree profile or back view. Turn head/chest/pelvis/both feet consistently toward that enemy. Intent focused and alert, youthful determined eyebrows and closed mouth, not angry screaming.
POSE: Lower center of gravity with BOTH KNEES modestly bent. Stable feet spread in depth, anatomical RIGHT plated boot leading toward screen-right, LEFT blue-cloth boot trailing toward screen-left. Both feet planted, no running/jumping/attack swing. Torso slightly leans forward, hips balanced over support. Anatomical RIGHT HAND holds the LONGSWORD forward toward the imagined enemy: blade angled diagonally upward toward screen-right from a firmly gripped hilt in front of waist/lower chest; near right elbow remains naturally bent, not fully locked. Anatomical LEFT HAND holds the SHORT ANGULAR DAGGER in a compact protective guard near the opposite upper waist/chest, pointed toward screen-right/up but visually separate from the longsword. Keep both hands/wrists and BOTH weapon hilts readable, no impossible crossing/interpenetration. Exactly two arms, two hands, one longsword and one short dagger. Thumb opposes curled fingers around actual grip; forearm/wrist/palm continuous; pommel-handle-guard-blade one coherent straight weapon axis. Do not grip blades or guard tips.
IDENTITY/EQUIPMENT LOCK: anatomical RIGHT crescent pauldron and silver plated shin/boot, LEFT blue cloth wrapped boot with metal buckles/protectors; silver faceted armor and gauntlets, blue scarf and SHORT lowered hood, blue waist cloth, brown double belts/right-hip pouch/trousers. RIGHT-hand longsword retains BLUE DIAGONAL blade accents, silver WING-SHAPED GUARD and RING knuckle protector; LEFT-hand dagger retains its SHORT ANGULAR silver blade and small guard. Near right shoulder/arm and plated shin visible; do not swap anatomical sides. Layered hair and scarf can shift slightly with the braced stance, no new long cape/helmet/motifs/gear.
STYLE: preserve original clean stepped-pixel contours, controlled internal linework, silver cel facets, chunky blue cloth shadows and brown leather blocks. No soft paint, smooth vector, photoreal anatomy or 3D. Preserve face and original moderate SD proportions; crouching shortens displayed pose height but does not enlarge the head. Entire hair, elbows, boots and all blade tips fully inside the canvas with safe empty margin, leave sufficient room on RIGHT for forward weapon reach. True alpha transparent backdrop, no enemy actually drawn, no ground/scene, no effects/speed lines/motion blur/text/watermark. Clear readable combat silhouette, a ready guard rather than a completed strike.
